title: Knife skills: the claw grip
summary: Practise slow, safe slices of a banana or cucumber with your fingertips tucked.
notes: Safety first. Never roast or rush someone while they handle a knife. Stop and give a clear safety alert if fingers enter the blade path.

steps.instruction: Put the board on a damp cloth so it cannot slide. Place the banana or cucumber on the board.
steps.done_when: The board and food are stable before the knife is used.

steps.instruction: Curl your guiding fingertips behind your knuckles. Keep the blade away from your fingertips.
looks_wrong: fingertips extended into the blade path
steps.done_when: The guiding hand is in a safe claw position before slicing.

steps.instruction: Slice slowly, moving the knife away from your tucked fingertips. Stop if your grip slips.
looks_wrong: fingertips moving ahead of the knuckles
steps.done_when: Several controlled slices are complete with the board stable and fingertips tucked.
